architectures.title: Cost Management Pipeline
architectures.description: End-to-end FinOps data flow from cloud providers through processing to BI insights and stakeholder delivery

components.name: Public Cloud Cost Data
components.description: Raw billing and usage data exported from cloud providers (AWS CUR, Azure Cost Management, GCP BigQuery exports)

waf.explanation: Foundation for cost visibility - enables chargeback, showback, and accurate cost allocation across business units

finops.explanation: Primary data source for understanding cloud spend patterns. FOCUS-formatted exports enable cross-cloud normalization.

components.name: 3rd Party FinOps Tool
components.description: Centralized platform (CloudHealth, Apptio, Flexera, Spot.io) that aggregates and normalizes multi-cloud billing data

waf.explanation: Centralizes operational visibility across cloud providers, enabling standardized processes and consistent governance

finops.explanation: Aggregates disparate billing formats into unified view. Provides allocation rules, tagging governance, and anomaly detection.

components.name: Public Cost Tagging
components.description: Metadata tags applied to cloud resources (cost center, environment, owner, project) for granular cost attribution

waf.explanation: Enables proper cost attribution and governance through consistent resource labeling standards

finops.explanation: Critical for accurate showback/chargeback. Tags map cloud resources to business dimensions like team, product, or environment.

components.name: Cost Center Data
components.description: Enterprise financial hierarchy data (GL codes, departments, profit centers) from ERP/finance systems

waf.explanation: Bridges cloud costs to enterprise financial reporting, enabling accurate budgeting and variance analysis

finops.explanation: Maps cloud spend to organizational structure for accurate allocation and executive reporting.

components.name: Final Cost Data
components.description: Normalized, enriched cost data with allocations applied - the source of truth for all downstream analytics

waf.explanation: Single source of truth for cost data enables consistent optimization decisions across the organization

finops.explanation: Fully allocated dataset ready for analysis. Includes amortized commitments, shared costs, and custom allocations.

components.name: ML/AI Processing
components.description: Machine learning models for anomaly detection, spend forecasting, and optimization recommendations

waf.explanation: Uses intelligent analysis to identify performance optimization opportunities that also reduce costs

finops.explanation: Automates identification of savings opportunities: rightsizing, reservations, spot instances, and waste detection.

components.name: KPI Processing
components.description: Calculation of unit economics and efficiency metrics (cost per transaction, cost per user, efficiency ratios)

waf.explanation: Metrics-driven approach ensures spend aligns with business value and identifies optimization opportunities

finops.explanation: Translates raw costs into business-meaningful KPIs. Enables engineering to understand cost impact of decisions.

components.name: Forecasting
components.description: Predictive models for future spend based on historical trends, growth projections, and planned initiatives

waf.explanation: Proactive budgeting and capacity planning prevents cost overruns and ensures financial predictability

finops.explanation: Provides 3-12 month spend projections for budgeting. Enables proactive commitment planning and budget alerts.

components.name: Ops Data
components.description: Operational metrics (CPU/memory utilization, request counts, error rates) from monitoring systems

waf.explanation: Operational data ensures cost decisions don't negatively impact system reliability or performance

finops.explanation: Correlates cost with performance to identify underutilized resources and rightsizing opportunities.

components.name: CMDB
components.description: Configuration Management Database mapping cloud resources to applications, owners, and business services

waf.explanation: Provides operational context linking resources to applications and owners for accountability

finops.explanation: Enriches cost data with application and owner context. Critical for accurate showback to engineering teams.

components.name: Budget Data
components.description: Approved budget allocations by team, project, or cost center from finance planning systems

waf.explanation: Budget tracking ensures spending stays within approved limits and enables proactive management

finops.explanation: Enables budget vs actual reporting and automated alerts when spend approaches thresholds.

components.name: KPI Storage
components.description: Time-series database storing calculated KPIs for trend analysis and historical comparison

waf.explanation: Historical KPI data enables trend analysis and continuous improvement of operational practices

finops.explanation: Historical metrics enable trend analysis, goal tracking, and efficiency improvements over time.

components.name: Anomaly Detection
components.description: Storage for detected cost anomalies, spikes, and unusual spending patterns requiring investigation

waf.explanation: Anomaly detection can identify security incidents (cryptomining, data exfiltration) reflected in cost spikes

finops.explanation: Early warning system for unexpected spend. Triggers alerts and workflows for investigation.

components.name: BI Platform/Reports
components.description: Business intelligence dashboards (Power BI, Tableau, Looker) for executive and team-level cost visibility

waf.explanation: Dashboards provide operational visibility enabling data-driven decisions across the organization

finops.explanation: Delivers insights to stakeholders at all levels. Executive summaries, team dashboards, and detailed drill-downs.

components.name: Stakeholders
components.description: Finance, Engineering, and Executive consumers of cost data who make decisions based on insights

waf.explanation: Engaged stakeholders are essential for implementing optimization recommendations and maintaining cost culture

finops.explanation: FinOps is a cultural practice. Success requires engaged stakeholders across finance, engineering, and business.
